non_claims: A depth-ray result is a visible surface-point candidate, not the cup center, object pose, calibration result, or accepted world target.
The virtual depth encoding is used only under the frozen MuJoCo contract; no relation to Orbbec units or real depth errors is established.
No fit, fusion, planning, IK, collision, grasp, safety, robot action, or hardware I/O is evaluated.
pass_conditions: each frozen depth foreground mask has one component and supplies a finite current-depth median at its centroid-neighborhood pixels
each detected component creates one finite, forward camera-ray surface point; its evaluation-only offset from cup center is recorded without a tolerance
no center fitting, fusion, Coordinator, or execution is applied
